claim_audit.claim: Sky Mavis reported 38,000 daily active players in April and over two million in October 2021
claim_audit.locator: Leaving our Mark on History, first bullet
claim_audit.qualification: The report was published 5 October 2021. The copy attributes these figures to Sky Mavis; it does not assert independent auditing.

claim_audit.claim: A battle team comprised three Axies; the creatures were NFT assets
claim_audit.locator: Alpha guide: Battle System Mechanics and Downloading the Application; YGG: opening statement on NFT asset loans

claim_audit.claim: Battle play could generate SLP, which could be traded or used to breed Axies; breeding also required AXS
claim_audit.locator: Alpha guide: Breeding & Earning; Season 18: Economic Adjustments; Breeding Fee Adjustment opening and core concepts
claim_audit.qualification: Smooth Love Potion naming checked against the April migration and November Katana announcements. No fixed breeding cost, reward rate or guaranteed payout is stated.

claim_audit.claim: Scholarships lent NFT assets and divided gameplay rewards without transferring ownership to the player
claim_audit.locator: YGG July report: opening paragraph and Scholarship Update; explainer: What is a Scholarship?
claim_audit.qualification: YGG provides a documented example. Its particular three-way percentage split is neither reproduced nor treated as universal; the artwork simplifies the relationship into player and owner.

claim_audit.claim: YGG reported more than 10,000 Axie scholars at the end of 2021
claim_audit.qualification: Published 7 January 2022 and expressly retrospective about the end of 2021; not evidence of that scale throughout the whole year.

claim_audit.claim: Axie reduced some SLP rewards in August and adjusted breeding costs in September 2021
claim_audit.locator: Season 18: Economic Adjustments; Breeding Fee Adjustment announcement
claim_audit.qualification: Reward reductions were mode-specific, not a claim that every reward fell.

claim_audit.claim: The token economy was imbalanced and volatile; playing did not guarantee stable income
claim_audit.locator: Season 18: mint/burn imbalance; Breeding Fee Adjustment: volatility, sustainability and growth discussion
claim_audit.qualification: The no-guarantee statement is a cautious implication of variable token prices and changing reward rules, not a quantified livelihood assessment.

Do not promise profit, sustainable income, a fixed daily wage, a universal payout split or automatic ownership of borrowed Axies.
Keep Axie NFT assets, SLP rewards and the separate AXS breeding input conceptually distinct.
Use actual final-image clues only. No clock, calendar, controller or Ronin bridge token is present.
Do not imply literal holograms, a documented person or household, a screenshot of gameplay, or an authentic payout record.
The later-updated creature chart is an art-design reference only, not evidence for the historical claims.
